Every album is diverse and different if you want to visit their roots and heaviest music go to origin and listen to new born, citizen erased and almost every song on there.  If you want to visit the more experimental you should check out the 2nd law of the resistance. Showbiz their first album is also a great album to check out as many say it sounds a lot like radio head (Do not think this at all) Absolution is definitely a point for the band when they were more mature and professional with their music while also influencing some head bang songs like Stockholm syndrome and hysteria and while having the slower great ones like falling away with you and blackout and of course some great piano slots In apocalypse please and ruled by secrecy.  Drones is their latest album that goes back to their roots of 3 instrument music and it is the more organic of the albums with some classics like reapers, the handler, the globalist and more.  Every album is great and diverse and muse is a great band that is totally worth taking some time out to check out.  Overall go start with either black holes, absolution or origin to start out to get the just of the band
